outcome: Rates of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: 7,188,972 births in the United States (6,316,743 in urban hospitals, 837,772 in rural hospitals)
finding: From 2002 to 2010, both rural and urban hospitals saw an increase in cesarean rates and a decrease in VBAC rates, with nonindicated labor induction rates rising disproportionately faster in rural settings.
